data.name: Liferaft
data.description: Liferaft is a U.S.-headquartered biochar company focused on durable carbon capture and restoring rural economies, which finalized an agreement in March 2026 to supply Microsoft with one million carbon removal units over ten years. The company operates biochar facilities in Iowa and Illinois, with the Microsoft deal facilitated by Supercritical, producing biochar via pyrolysis of agricultural and municipal biomass that is blended with compost for agricultural soil applications.
